title: CONNECT-UDP Forwarding Policy Work Item
summary: Add forwarding, congestion, QUIC DATAGRAM, and ECN policy helpers for CONNECT-UDP.
planned_changes:

- Add focused tests and canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run focused forwarding-policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, coverage triage generation, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: Live ICMP Packet Too Big emission.
completion_notes: The RFC 9298 forwarding/congestion/ECN policy surface is implemented and verified locally.
